notes.title: Eternal Strands Spring Update: Stargazer ✨🪽
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/ef3bca43d0d20cea9ada78fba211311d897fadfa.png[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
For this special update, Yellow Brick Games teamed up with Creative Studio III’s Yusuke Mogi, the visionary artist known for his art in FINAL FANTASY XIV Online, to co-develop stunning original content. This partnership brings The Ark of the Nova, a powerful new aerial Epic, which wields all three major magic types on the battlefield, providing a formidable opponent for Brynn and the Weaverband. 

Note: This content becomes available at Part 4 of the game.

[h2]New map: Starlight Cape [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/00084811cc5bde2f1c92ba1450e30f7c1dbe2a44.jpg[/img]

Step into an uncharted territory filled with fresh vertical challenges, a new Elite Fire Summon minion, and additional lore that pull Brynn and her companions even deeper into the Enclave’s mysteries

[h2]New Epic: The Ark of the Nova [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/11d071c7b91ddc27e779ef503fa70ac4e5da8a66.jpg[/img]

This unique flying Ark can use its Starscopes to attune to all three strains of magic in order to wield them in powerful, targeted attacks. 

[h2]New Questline from Oria + New Codex entries [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/495975f978f62e9c5aa69bafd17d2aa2419a0bf6.png[/img]

Obtain a Keyswatch from Oria to explore Starlight Cape, defeat the Ark of the Nova and collect new Codex entries to learn more about this mysterious area of The Enclave. 

[h2]New minion: Elite Fire Summon [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/0ee52f50e421b4024729c1f80e84b669fb9b1ecf.png[/img]

A new minion is now present in the Enclave! Battle the Elite Fire Summon minion in Starlight Cape for the first time.  

[h2]New power: Celestial Scope[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/eaf0c2f7bfa577618cec08b861f61f7a8c7038be.jpg[/img]

Inspired by The Ark of the Nova, this ability unlocks a dynamic drone that synergizes with Brynn’s existing magical spells to provide even more unique gameplay opportunities for players. 

[h2]New weapon designs[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/47fcfaaed5ef54bf426c89c78a38c983bc857ce3.jpg[/img]

The Stargazer Two-Hander (Kinetic), Sword and Shield (Flame) and Bow & Arrow (Frost) are uniquely mystical in appearance and can be a great addition to any one of Brynn’s armor sets.  

[h2]New armor: Umbral set[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/886e6ef4e0b4c047e1ab989f000f597b4dc055a2.jpg[/img]

Find new recipes in Starlight Cape to unlock the Umbral set, a timeless lightweight outfit with a magical twist. 

[h2]New feature: Dyeing system[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/655b2ec21976900f804a46d7f6ffde2026687caa.jpg[/img]

Players can finally customize their armor’s colors without affecting stats, bringing more personalization to the adventure! The dyeing system doesn’t affect the shape of the armor, but it will allow players to make use of their cumulated resources to experiment with a variety of colour schemes for their gear.  

[h2]New resources[/h2]

Players also now have 4 new resources to gather (from the Ark of the Nova and the Elite Fire Summon) and craft with: 

Woven ★★★★ : Astral Cloth 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/081a2d11ae4bd523d919e0c64838377d8bfef8ee.png[/img]

Carved ★★★★: Ruby Core 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/3be87013622dd3c5d307a7de60d84dec637b2572.png[/img]

Tanned ★★★★★: Nova Membrane 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/da67fc706ae967a4e57c4edf5aaca01b66a29421.png[/img]

Carved ★★★★★: Arctic Obsidian 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/0a3b31817a533262a33fcbf3a7361d86fef2bfdd.png[/img]

[h2]New difficulty setting: Story Mode [/h2]

Players requested a more accessible way to experience Eternal Strands' world & story without as intense of a challenge. The Story Mode was created with this in mind and is now available in the Gameplay menu.  

[h1]New Quality of Life features [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/0b5ae854acfde80e389dd5b3e54cacc12e9c3b03.png[/img]

Thanks to lots of valuable detailed and constructive feedback from our community, we’ve been able to implement a list of quality of life changes that we believe will bring significant improvements to both the new player and veteran player experience. 

[h2]Gameplay [/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved hit reactions on minion enemies. 
[*] When player dies, if the number of resources gathered on their expedition in their inventory is lower than the safety pouch limit, the end of expedition menu (safety pouch selection) is skipped and the player keeps their resources. 
[*] Ice Gauntlet now passively reduces stamina consumption when equipped, to make it possible for the player to keep the Ice Gauntlet on while climbing a shaking Epic (as clinging is disabled when the Ice Gauntlet is equipped). 
[*] Added a ceiling limit to brittleness for HP bags. 
[*] Watcher’s wisp is now granted earlier, at the start of Part 1. 
[/list]

[h2]UI & Progression[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased enticement range of Part 1 quest objectives, to support navigation in early game for new players. 
[*] Added various tutorial entries (loot bag, fall damage, elite minion, weapon and armor bonuses, and more!) and created a tutorial menu prompt at Oria’s station. 
[*] Added a codex menu at Laen's station. 
[*] Enabled stat gauge display for all stats in equipment screen (previously only displayed heat/cold resistance stat variations). 
[*] Added a new "on expedition" option for the “Show Helmet” option Now, players can choose to show their equipped helmet while out on expedition, but hide it in Basecamp & Cassidan’s Hold to be able to view Brynn’s face in these areas.  
[*] Attunement panels now show counters for codex fragments, gear designs, and loomgates in Cassidan’s Hold and Basecamp (previously only displayed a description).  
[*] Added a new quest at end of the main game to help players collect all remaining codex. 
[*] Colored resource pickup text to match the rarity of the resource. 
[*] Added a HUD prompt to appear when there is no valid active objective that the wisps can guide the player to. 
[*] Enabled damage numbers on breakable objects hit with kinetic magic. 
[*] Added a UI feature to indicate mana depletion to the player. If the player doesn’t have enough mana to use a power or weapon ability, the corresponding icon’s color in the HUD will be desaturated and its opacity lowered.  
[*] Added a “Loadout” tab in Menus that displays Brynn’s equipped wepaons and armor along with their stats.  
[*] Added a change that gives priority to interactions that can be completed when there are many near the player (eg: interaction with resources is given priority over health potions when player is full on health potions but has space in their inventory). 
[*] Adjusted the DLSS Application to follow Nvidia UI guidelines.  
[*] Implemented a Confirmation pop-up message when the player chooses the “Restore Default Settings” option in menus. 
[*] Adjusted Camera Sensitivity settings for Bow Aiming and Casting. 
[*] Fixed DLSS Anti-Aliasing (DLAA). Now sets Anti-Aliasing to TSR when using DLSS in order for DLAA to work properly. 
[*] Added an “Abandon Expedition” option to the System menu. 
[*] Added a failsafe safety pouch for players when first entering gameplay state. This will enable a player to save some of their loot in the event of a game crash during an expedition. This also triggers a safety pouch menu when the player exits to main menu or quits the game. 
[*] A save is now automatically triggered upon looting a resource. In the event of a system or game crash, more loot will now be retained on reloading of the game. 
[/list]

[h2]Settings & Controls [/h2]

[list]
[*] Made last selected option in certain menus (system, load, save) persistent. 
[*] Added the option to delete save slots in the Save and Load menus. 
[*] Additional support for variety of keyboard layouts. 
[*] Added an option for PC players to clear key bindings. 
[*] Added descriptions to mappable keys, giving players more information on controls. 
[*] Added the option to toggle certain action inputs instead of holding them (sprint, open wheel and casting stance). 
[*] Added a 3rd controller scheme that allows swapping of L1/R1 mappings to L2/R2 mappings. In this scheme, the Magic wheel control is mapped to R1 and Block/Parry/Bow are mapped to L1. 
[*] Adjusted the DLSS Application to follow Nvidia UI guidelines. 
[*] Adjusted the DLSS Application to follow Nvidia UI guidelines.  
[*] Implemented a Confirmation pop-up message when the player chooses the “Restore Default Settings” option in menus. 
[*] Adjusted Camera Sensitivity settings for Bow Aiming and Casting. 
[*] Fixed DLSS Anti-Aliasing (DLAA). Now sets Anti-Aliasing to TSR when using DLSS in order for DLAA to work properly. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[h2]Performance[/h2]

[list]
[*] Various performance improvements.  
[*] Disabled DX11 launch support. 
[*] Fixed an issue causing Southwall Waystation (Basecamp) graphics to be tinted bright red. 
[*] Fixed textures disappearing on all graphics settings (PC).  
[/list]

[h2]World [/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed floating objects in Prologue, Lower Dynevron, The Bastion and Basecamp. 
[*] Fixed unbreakable objects in Upper and Lower Dynevron. 
[*] Fixed an exploit to prevent loot farming with Spitfire nests. 
[*] Fixed an area where player could navigate out of bounds in the Prologue.   
[*] Fixed a bug that caused inconsistencies in how lanterns explode. 
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay [/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved parry reactivity & precision in Epic combat.  
[*] Fixed a bug in which Epic attacks without interruption when the player is out of reach. 
[*] Fixed a bug in which Ark of the Winter Tide wasn’t using its ice sphere ability if Brynn was unreachable but close. 
[*] Fixed a bug in which combatting the Conjurer during a Flash freeze modifier didn’t grant any advantage. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Ark of the Forge’s belt armor to stretch too wide, causing unintended physics collisions.  
[*] Fixed a bug preventing NPCs from entering combat after being attacked by the player under certain conditions.   
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from harvesting the Highland Iceclaw in Arkon’s Hearth.  
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Brennig Glasstail to become passive/unresponsive during combat. 
[*] Fixed a bug causing certain minions to attack Epics. 
[*] Fixed a bug causing tier 3 kinetic streams to negatively affect the player's capacity to hold onto Epics because of the power’s velocity. 
[*] Fixed inconsistencies occuring with ice power generation in certain circumstances. 
[*] Strengthened ice power generation when used by player to create bridges.  
[*] Fixed Rehnland Sledgewyrm’s offset kinetic bubble throws.  
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player to get stuck in slow motion when aiming the bow & arrow. 
[/list]

[h2]VFX & UI[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which cursor resets to the first choice in dialogue options too quickly. 
[*] Fixed text positioning in dialogue for certain localizations.

[/list]

[h2]Progression[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing “The Tapestry” quest text from loading.  
[*] Fixed an issue preventing players from unlocking the Smoked achievement, even when all criteria was met.  
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that cancelled rumble events on PC.   
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the bow to stop zooming and reticle to flicker when chaining arrow shots.  
[*] Fixed a bug causing the background to disappear in Cassidan’s Hold during dialogue in certain circumstances.

notes.title: ETERNAL STRANDS ROADMAP 👀
notes.content:
Hello, Weavers! 🪄 
 
It is with great pleasure that we are finally ready to share Eternal Strands’ official update and content Roadmap with you! 🛣️⬇️ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/f094af8f1f5ad816ca19c5235c07a7bd299a9cc1.png[/img]
 
Thank you again to everyone who played the demo and/or the main game and took the time to share your constructive feedback, comments and thoughts with us. Thanks to your input and insights, we were able to make some updates to Eternal Strands that we believe will make the overall experience that much more enjoyable and smooth for everyone who decides to venture into The Enclave.  
 
[u]In the roadmap, you’ll notice three significant changes in our next patch:  [/u]
[list]
[*] Movement improvements 
[*] Combat improvements 
[*] Changes to the penalty for deaths from falls 
[/list]
In this article, we want to take the time to explain these upcoming changes in a bit more detail. ⬇️ 

[h1]Movement improvements 🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ [/h1]
We heard your feedback about the sometimes “slippery” feeling of Brynn’s movements in the game. Some of you described that her walking/running felt a little bit too much like “skating” and that the lack of precision could be frustrating at times.  

Something to note about Brynn’s movement is that much of how it feels is intended and attributable to how a 100% physics-based sandbox game like Eternal Strands is designed to work. Being an object that reacts to the physics surrounding her, just like any other object in the world, means that her weight and inertia have an impact on her movement. It can take some time for Brynn to accelerate or decelerate and there is some nuance in how far kinetic magic can displace her (based on weight of gear equipped) or how far she’s pushed by an epic or heavy object hitting her (based on weight of gear equipped and weight + velocity of the object impacting her). All this to say that Brynn’s movement can’t be as snappy or reactive as it is in games that rely on animation.  

That said, based on your feedback, we did take a closer look at what we could change that might have an impact on movement precision. Through this investigation, we did indeed identify and make a few subtle but noticeable tweaks that we think improve the overall experience and feeling of gameplay in Eternal Strands. ⬇️ 

[list]
[*] Brynn’s minimum acceleration speed has been enhanced.  
[*] After the next update, reaching a target speed or slowing down to a full stop will happen quicker. This will decrease the “sliding” players have experienced at almost all weights (except the lightest, which still has some inevitable “skating”).  
[*] Direction changes will be much "snappier". 
[/list]
[h1]Combat improvements ⚔️ [/h1]
Now, for combat! Most of you mentioned that you enjoyed the weapons, the mechanics, parrying system and boss fights. We did, however, hear many of you say that you would appreciate more responsiveness from the combat In Eternal Strands. Our designers read through your comments and based on your feedback, identified a series of small changes to implement that, altogether, provide a significant difference in the way combat feels.   
 
[h2]Enemy Hit Reactions  [/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemies will react faster, more often, and with more ‘oomph’ when hit by the player. 
[*] We’ve implemented a directional hit reaction system, where enemies will react in the direction relative to the player’s attack. For a perfect example, try hitting the Acalas with the charged combo of the Two-Handed Blade. Their heads get smashed to the ground! 
[*] Some attacks will do heavier reactions (such as the Two-Handed Blade’s first 2 attacks), which will allow you to interrupt enemy attacks. 
[*] Controller rumble/vibration has been added. 
[/list]
[h2]Impact VFX [/h2]
[list]
[*] The visual effects that play when players hit an enemy have been tweaked to be more prominent. 
[/list]
[h2]Weapon improvements [/h2]
[h3]Two-Handed Blade [/h3]
[list]
[*] The standard 2H's base combo will be slightly faster and more reactive. 
[*] The kinetic 2H's ability will be more reliable and consistent, so the angles will be more appropriate while falling, jumping, or running. 
[*] This will improve the kinetic 2H in combat as well! Enemies will get launched with you at the same arc, which will make it easier to attack them mid-air. 
[/list]
[h3]Sword & Shield [/h3]
[list]
[*] The Sword & Shield sprint attack movement distance has been updated to better fit the attack, so you will no longer overshoot the target. 
[/list]
[h1]Changes to the death penalty for falls 🕳️ [/h1]
When you add traversal magic to a physics-based game set in a high verticality world with giant enemies... Lots of chaos ensues ❤️‍🔥. It’s part of (we think) what makes Eternal Strands fun in its own, unique way – and that is definitely intended design. However, in reading your feedback, we did realize that while fun, that chaos can quickly sour an experience if falling to your death is caused by something entirely out of your control (aka: some of the inevitable jank that comes with a physics game). That unpredictability can also discourage riskier experimentation, like creating an ice bridge or testing the kinetic stream’s distance over a cliff, for example.   
 
To limit the frustrations that arise from these types of circumstances, we’ve removed the penalty from falling deaths. After this update, if you try yeeting yourself onto that little island in Upper Dynevron with an ensnaring blast but miss your landing and plummet into the Miasma, you’ll respawn at the nearest Loomgate with all of your loot.  

[h1]Reddit AMA  🗣️ [/h1]
We are hosting an AMA with some of our devs over on r/EternalStrands tomorrow, Thursday February 27th at 11AM ET. If you have any burning questions about how Eternal Strands was made, what inspired the team, the lore & story in the game, what future features and content we have planned, or anything else you want to know - join us and ask away! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/c8053687e880b65b99dd2c4daa9e747974a9d96c.jpg[/img]

We will of course update this roadmap with more detailed information in the near future, so please continue sharing your valuable feedback and insights with us! We read everything you post and take all of your experiences with Eternal Strands into consideration as we move forward with implementing fixes, updates and content for the game.  
 
We hope to see you in the forums,  
- The Yellow Brick Team

notes.title: Eternal Strands Release: What you need to know 📝
notes.content:
Weavers, we’ve made it : Eternal Strands releases on all platforms tomorrrow, January 28th 2025 11AM ET ! 
 
Here’s everything you need to know before you meet your Weaverband ⤵️ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/4bd7ead2474eff055ae41e3c537307b865b1bd76.png[/img]

[b]❓Will my PC demo progress carry over to the full game? [/b]
Yes. Eternal Strands doesn’t support cross-saves though, so your progress will carry over if your demo and full game are on the same platform (EGS or Steam).  

[b]❓ What are the system requirements for the game?  [/b]
Here’s a handy visual with both minimum and recommended specs. These apply to both the demo and the full game ⤵️ 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/b35871c841ad63599ba15d98768dd4b7cc6b4049.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/a2ccdc37405eb11454357ed83652ff0b8e9606be.png[/img]

39.99 USD / 49.99 CAD. Eternal Strands will be priced at $39.99USD/$49.99CAD. Regional prices are also available across platforms.

English and French have both voice over and subtitles, while Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, and German have subtitle support.  

Please note: Korean language is only available on STOVE and consoles at this time. 

[b]❓What accessibility options are in the game? [/b]
You’ll be able to browse through all of our accessibility options in the game’s menus. Some settings you can expect to see are: difficulty options, motion blur, subtitle size, colour blind modes, and more. 

[b]❓Can I play the game on Steamdeck? [/b]
You can! We are not yet verified (still working on it!) but can confirm that Eternal Strands is playable on Steamdeck.  

[b]❓Where can I learn more about the gameplay loop and mechanics before I dive in? [/b]
If you want a quick summary of Eternal Strands’ gameplay basics, you can check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AHxtabO0hj8]101 gameplay trailer[/url].

You can also head over to our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@yellowbrickgames_qc]TikTok[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/@yellowbrickgames_qc/shorts]YouTube Shorts channel[/url] for some short-form gameplay videos that give a good glimpse of what you can do in Eternal Strands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/8d22f1dd05b9a36ec3cb8a16433d804692ba2519.png[/img]

To help you get started in Eternal Strands, we’ve put together a list of a few handy early game tips & tricks.  This information will all eventually be available in the game’s tutorial panels as you progress, but we noticed during the demo that some of it was helpful to have going in – so here’s a summary of some key points:  

[list]
[*] [b]Prologue[/b] :  In the game’s opening hour, you can expect more linear exploration, tutorials, and cut scenes to introduce you to the story & world.  
[*] [b]Basecamp & dialogue[/b] : After the prologue, you’ll start the game at Basecamp with your Weaverband. You can choose to speak to them and get to know who they are, or you can skip this part and go straight into exploring The Enclave. 
[u]Handy tip[/u]: You have an autoplay dialogue option in your Menus. 

[*] [b]Basekit abilities[/b] : You’ll start the game with a sword & shield and bow & arrow as your available weapons. You’ll also have access to your Ice Wall spell and Weaver’s Grasp spell. As you gather loot and defeat Epics, you’ll get to craft new gear/weapons and weave new magic strands into your Mantle. 
[*] [b]Finding resources & managing inventory[/b] : As you head out into The Enclave, you’ll find a lot of loot, right away. You’ll quickly notice that your inventory space is limited, though each type of loot stacks up to 99. Every time you go back to basecamp, your loot will automatically be deposited at your tent, and your inventory cleared. As you progress in the game, you’ll be able to upgrade Casmyn’s station which will grow your inventory space. 
[u]Note[/u] : We’ve heard feedback in the demo that players would prefer their base inventory to be larger. This is something we’ll be addressing in a future update 😊 

[*] [b]Equipping gear & armor[/b]: You’ll find crafting recipes on your expedition into the Enclave. If you open your map while out exploring, you’ll see small forging hammers in the areas where recipes can be discovered. Sola can craft weapons and armor for you back at basecamp, and you can switch your equipped gear before you head back out by visiting Casmyn’s caravan.  
[*] [b]Combat [/b]: In menus, mouse and keyboard players can customize keybinding and controller players can choose between two different controller schemes. You can pull up the magic wheel to switch spells and/or weapons. 
[u]Handy tip[/u]: There is a parry system in the game, which you can trigger with the right block timing on enemy attacks.  

[*] [b]Camera[/b]: There is a lock on/off function, as well as a precision aim toggle for your bow & arrow. Your controls menu will show you where those are on your keyboard or controller. 
[*] [b]Fast travel/Teleportation[/b]: At first, when you go out to explore, you’ll have to walk your way back to Basecamp. Early in your game progress though, you’ll obtain a Loomshard from Laen, which will allow you to quickly teleport back to basecamp from anywhere out in The Enclave.
[*] [b]Navigation[/b] : You have a compass which can be toggled on in your menus. You also unlock the Weaver’s Wisp (navigation tool) early in the game which will guide you towards your next objective.  
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Update #4 🧵🪡
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/35f6df90fd914efa7e36cd0c71828c04805b611e.png[/img]

Hello again, Weavers! 👋🏼 
 
Eternals Strands’ free demo (PC only) is releasing in only one week (!!!) and we can’t wait for you all to experience our debut game! The (yellow brick) road we built to get here has been both wonderful and challenging. It feels quite surreal to know that we are finally reaching the finish line (or rainbow, to stay in line with the analogy 🌈). Thank you to every single one of you who has been following along and supporting us throughout the development of Eternal Strands, we can’t thank you enough 💛. 
 
In preparation for our upcoming demo and full launch, we‘d like to share some more in-depth information on the topic of progression and how the team designed it for Eternal Strands. So without further ado, let’s get into it! 
 
Side note for those of you wondering: Yes, your progress will carry over from the demo to the game! On January 20th, we’ll post a detailed article covering everything you need to know prior to loading into the demo.  Until then, fear not, we’ve got you covered 🤝. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/49c10e0d8fe5ad6f9973d52ccd17f0efe099087a.png[/img]

In Eternal Strands, there are no experience points, which means that your progression is mainly based on what you have equipped. The gear and armor that you will be equipping can’t be found nor can it be bought as there is no in-game currency or shop loop in Eternal Strands. This means that you must craft everything! ⚒️   
 
As you might expect, this translates into a core gameplay loop that involves going out into The Enclave to find materials and smithing recipes that you can then bring back to your basecamp’s forge.   

However, there is one key component to looting that is essential in understanding Eternal Strands and maximizing each one of your exploration runs: the magic that you use (frost or flame) to destroy an object or defeat an enemy will affect your loot drops. For example: using flame magic will remove any cloth/woven/tanned/leather materials from your drop options, as it will favor metals and carvable materials instead.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/da8d35a77e829df524ad34b1e3381e856a55aa5f.png[/img]

As mentioned above, in order for Sola to be able to craft new gear or weapons for Brynn, you’ll need to provide her with:  

[list]
[*] A recipe to follow (aka crafting instructions) 📝 
[*] The amount of material types indicated in said recipe ✅ 
[/list]

Crafting recipes can be found in The Enclave by exploring its different areas and all of their hidden nooks & crannies. Each armor/weapon design starts with baseline stats that can be altered based on the materials used.  Additionally, some equipment pieces offer a bonus, like more health points or weight reduction, for example.
 
Each recipe calls for a set amount of material types, but you have freedom in choosing what specific resource you want to use as long is it meets the category criteria. For example, the recipe might call for 6 woven resources. When you click on that material category, a selection window will open showing you all of the resources you have in your inventory that match this criteria. Cycling through them will allow you to see the effect each one will have on your gear’s stats and appearance.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/ac6ac22817b2dccc334b6e1b593f376db8f9748b.jpg[/img]
 
You also have the option of reforging and/or upgrading your armor or weapon. Reforging involves dismantling your current piece, reclaiming the discarded materials in the process, and using different resources to reforge the same item. Upgrading an item requires using the same materials previously used in crafting the piece initially. Upgrading a piece will enhance its stats and appearance. 
 
Armor sets aren’t locked, so you can mix & match your pieces as you please to create the desired build that you want both in metrics and in aesthetics! 
 
Quick note for those of you reading this and wondering if there is a transmog system in Eternal Strands, the short answer is no. That said, it is something that the team would like to possibly implement in the future if we have the resources for it post-launch. While we can’t fully commit to this just yet, it’s not impossible! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/d91477a8a8fee61fde75a92ff0906179ab1a0be4.png[/img]
 

We didn’t forget the magic! Another progression point is of course Brynn’s magical abilities. When defeating an Epic for the first time, you'll obtain a strand of that creature’s power. This strand can then be brought to Dahm’s Atelier at basecamp in order to be sewn into your Mantle, granting you a version of the defeated Epic’s magical ability.  
 
When encountering previously defeated Epics, if you face them again and perform a certain set of actions in a certain order (no spoilers!) you’ll expose the creature’s locust point which will then allow you to harvest their magic. This is what will allow you to upgrade each one of your 9 magical abilities, up to a maximum of 3 levels per ability.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/d2efd9152ea3973946bb955ce887d2baf3834023.png[/img]
 
You can also use harvested magic to craft magical weapons. Each magic-imbued weapon will have a unique ability of its own that can be combined with your spells, making space for creative combat choices! If you want to read more on the Cast & Combine system, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1491410/view/4682144707315702711]check out this article[/url].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/579065f66396b0366464620d04a6f8a167430e8b.png[/img]

Last but not least, you can also progress by upgrading your basecamp companion’s stations, which will increasingly strengthen their ability to support Brynn on her missions. Stations can be upgraded by transforming materials into supplies at Casmyn’s caravan. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/340a8d00440b54433a390224c73d840d3b4d05e9.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Upgrading Sola’s Forge will make it possible for Sola to craft increasingly stronger, more complex designs for Brynn. 
[*] Upgrading Dahm’s atelier will give him the means to upgrade Brynn’s magical abilities to higher levels.  
[*] Upgrading Laen’s station will allow Brynn to carry more consumables on her belt (health potions, frost & flame resistance phials). 
[*] Upgrading Casmyn’s station will make it possible for Brynn to carry more inventory during her missions, and will give the scry the ability to salvage more resources when Brynn dies. 
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/9c0da7f291137ef644740deb99fe0a8f686f035a.png[/img]

That’s it for this Dev Update on progression. As always, feel free to drop your questions in the comments below if you have any.  
 
We hope to see you in the demo, Weavers! 

The Yellow Brick Team

notes.title: Exploring Eternal Strands' Codex 📖✨
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Mike from the Eternal Strands team here with a little deep dive about how we’re handling lore in our game. 

I’ve always been a big fan of games with rich backstories and a setting that extends beyond what’s strictly necessary for the game. It just makes the world feel more alive and gives the writing team interesting tidbits to drop into conversations. Better, I think it’s super cool to surface some of that lore to players through a system such as a “Codex” or “Glossary.” 

We faced an interesting dilemma with Strands, though: as an action-adventure game, we’re aware most players will be here for the monster fighting and cool abilities, so we didn’t want to bog down the exploration of our open zones with big blocks of text. Another consideration for me when designing our codex system is that I wanted to bring some element of “investigation” and the sense of piecing together the mysteries of the Enclave, and big lore dumps just from clicking a plaque or what have you didn’t feel like the right path. 

Thankfully, inspiration struck. Tonally, Eternal Strands is a game of what I’d call high adventure. Think a fantasy version of The Mummy, Tomb Raider, or Indiana Jones, and it was that latter touchstone that inspired the solution we went with. Rewatching The Last Crusade, I realized that something like Dr Henry Jones Sr.’s diary was exactly the vibe we were going for: fragments of information that make sense in the larger context. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/3f2ad05f430aa19d2ed12c33f7d8ddbad64f80a8.png[/img]

So, how does that translate into gameplay? First, when exploring the world, Brynn can come across what we call “knowledge fragments.” We made them glow to make them easier to spot (extra easy at night), which is a convenient feature for players, but I think it’s fair to say it’s sort of a manifestation of Brynn’s keen eye and curiosity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/ac65e1137405ae0041c3dd210dc95bc93bdacc99.jpg[/img]

Clicking on one won’t give you a big block of text, but instead a little fragment of information. A clue, bit of data or evidence, that kind of thing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/07ca349bef0497a6ddce60c10688f1bdfa26d8df.png[/img]

These fragments are then collected in the codex screen and grouped together under headings. You can check them at any time, and of course, we pre-load the codex with full entries for subjects Brynn knows about at the start of game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/069ffe4de2a097b8c4e854813f98befdfd66eed5.jpg[/img]

Once you have all the fragments for a subject, there’s enough information for the band’s Lorekeeper, Laen, to assemble a proper codex. Doing so grants the big, beefy compilation of information for you to read right then and there, or at your leisure when time allows. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/ea5f385e3b736eaacd77590706aff9ef34a69000.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/97edc5ed835eed967ade9f8ef9aed7b1a4573386.jpg[/img]

I’m pretty happy with the result: it keeps the information you find out in the field small and bite-sized, while giving you a chance to read the big, detailed results of your lorekeeper’s research in the safety of your band’s camp. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/79ebc17e5911129cefd2838b15693e3b0e224387.jpg[/img]

The fragments also play a role in your ability to predict the extreme weather that can sometimes hit the various regions of the Enclave, as well as what massive creature might be in each zone, so they’re useful to collect even if lore isn’t your thing. Also, as a bit of a comfort feature, the game tracks how many of the fragments you’ve found in each zone, so you’ll know when your hunt for knowledge in that space has been completed. You won’t need all the fragments in a zone to get all the gameplay data, of course. Collecting them all is for the lore buffs and explorers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/6e24005b393957d072e20e53eb1fea83bcc5565e.jpg[/img]

So, there you have it. A fun little feature that I thought might be fun to talk about. We’ll look forward to your feedback on it when you get to play Eternal Strands this January! 

- Mike Laidlaw, Creative Chief Officer - Yellow Brick Games

notes.title: Eternal Strands FAQ 🧵
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/fd9f1d1ec5ee0b5bfb92f42b445a25c6da88323b.png[/img]
[u]What type of game is Eternal Strands?  [/u]

Eternal Strands is a single-player action-adventure fantasy title that offers action-packed combat, a rich story, and innovative gameplay. 

[u]What games inspired Eternal Strands? [/u]

There are many games that inspired our project, but to name a few: Dragon’s Dogma, Shadow of the Colossus, and the bright, colorful art style of games like The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. 
 
[u]What makes Eternal Strands different?  [/u]

Our game seamlessly weaves together gigantic adversaries, raging flame, chilling ice, and telekinetic force. The world becomes your weapon, as you blend combat with raw magic, allowing for real-time destruction and reactivity as you battle colossal foes. Our new system for gameplay interactions leverages the power of Unreal 5 to reward player creativity in exploration as much as combat. We can’t wait to see how you turn the tides and uncover the mysteries the Enclave holds! 

[u]How do the gameplay mechanics work?  [/u]

Eternal Strands was designed to place reactive gameplay at the forefront of the player experience. Cast one of 9 magic spells (frost, flame or kinetic magic) and combine it with a different spell, a weapon ability, or something in the environment for a multitude of different interactions. The creative and strategic combat possibilities are endless!   

[u]Is this an open-world game? [/u]

While we have a few biomes within Eternal Strands, we would not classify the game as “open world,” but rather “open zone.” There are some interconnected areas, but by and large, these biomes have limitations in when you can access them defined by your progression through the story. 

[u]What is the gameplay loop? [/u]

Every day, you can head out into The Enclave to explore its treasures, fight enemies and gather resources. Return to basecamp to salvage your loot, craft new gear, upgrade your powers, catch up with your crew, and receive new quests. 

[u]What can you tell us about the looting & crafting system? [/u]

Materials and ressources that you collect on your expeditions across the different areas of the Enclave can be used to craft, reforge or upgrade your gear at Basecamp. Recipes are also hidden across the levels and once you find them, along with the required materials, you can then unlock new types of armor and weapons to craft. 

[u]What kind of weapons and armor will be available? [/u]

We have three main weapon types (e.g. sword & shield, bow & arrow, two-handed sword), but there are unique ways to customize all three. Each weapon type can be imbued with magic, for a total of 9 possible combinations. Each magic weapon comes with its own unique ability as well! 

[u]Will there be a mount or other ways of traversal? [/u]

No mounts or gliders – however, you can find ways to creatively get across the world in speed and style with Brynn’s kinetic powers 👀 

[u]When is the game releasing?  [/u]

January 28th 2025 🥳 on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Game Pass.  

[u]Will there be a public demo? [/u]

YES! We can confirm that a public demo will be available. More details will be shared at a later date.  

[u]Any post-launch content plans?  [/u]

Yes! We've partnered with Square Enix’s Creative Studio III (known for FINAL FANTASY XIV Online and FINAL FANTASY XVI) to design original post-launch content for Eternal Strands. The first post-launch update will be available for free, and will feature a new Epic creature, weapons and armor set designed in collaboration with Creative Studio III’s renowned Lead Artist Yusuke Mogi (known for FINAL FANTASY XIV Online). 

[u]Can you tell us more about the story?[/u]

In Eternal Strands, you embark on your journey as a young magic-wielding Weaver named Brynn. With the help of her Weaverband, a group of skilled companions that help her in her explorations, she seeks to unravel the secrets of The Enclave.  

A lifetime ago, The Enclave was a hub for magical development, trade, innovation and social life. But after arcane disasters spread across the Mayda region, it sealed itself away behind a magical wall known as the Veil. Decades of civil unrest followed and ever since, Weavers have been ostracized and condemned to nomadic lives.  

The story of Eternal Strands offers ways to build bonds and friendships with our rich cast of characters through dialogue choices. While the game itself does not have difficult moral choices that will sprawl out into multiple endings, or a giant social link system seen in games like Persona, you can still expect to see these dialogue choices impact Brynn’s personality and the way characters interact with her.  


[u]What can you tell us about Brynn, the protagonist? [/u]

Brynn is a badass treasure hunter and adrenaline junkie. She alone is responsible for diving headfirst into danger, and coming back with lost artifacts or treasure. Her expeditions are the driving force behind what her travelling companions are able to discover about the Enclave. She is the embodiment of the idea that “it’s cool to care,” and being unabashedly passionate about whatever it is you’re into. We can’t wait for players to meet her! 

[u]Is there a dog we can pet? [/u]

No dogs, but you can pet the Arva! 

[u]Who is going to be composing the music? [/u]

None other than legendary composer Austin Wintory, known for his work on projects like Journey, Stray Gods, and Assassin’s Creed Syndicate! 🎵💛 

[u]I’m a content creator - can I collaborate with the dev team or get a key to play the game? [/u]

Thank you for your interest – we'd love to connect with you 😊 You can apply to our partner program here: https://www.eternalstrandsgame.com/community or send us an email at press@yellowbrickgames.ca ! 

[u]Will there be key binding and controls customization options? [/u]

Yes, they’ll be available in the controls menu on release. 

[u]What specs are needed to run the game? [/u]

Minimum specs are: 
•  Performance: 60 FPS @ 1080p 
•  Graphic settings: Low 
•  GPU: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660 Super [6GB] / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT [6GB] / Intel Arc A580 
•  CPU:  Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3350G 
•  RAM: 8GB 
•  OS: Windows 10 / 11 
•  Additional Notes: SSD required.  

Recommended specs are: 
•  Performance: 60 FPS @ 1440p 
•  Graphic settings: High 
•  GPU:  GeForce RTX 3070 [8 GB] / Radeon RX 6800 [16GB] / Intel Arc A770 
•  CPU:  Intel Core i5-11600 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 
•  RAM 16GB 
•  OS: Windows 10 / 11 
•  Additional Notes: SSD required. 
 
We are also working towards being Steam verified. This will likely be available shortly after launch.  

Do you have more questions that aren't answered here? Drop them in the comments!

notes.title: Dev Update #3
notes.content:
Hello again, Weavers! 👋🏼 

In our second Developer Update last August, we gave you more insight into Eternal Strands’ weapons system and what unique abilities Brynn’s magic-imbued weapons have in store for you. Today, we want to touch on the topic of spells and how they can be cast & combined creatively in combat, exploration and navigation 👀 
 
[b]CAST & COMBINE  [/b]

So first things first, what do we mean by “cast & combine”? Our gameplay mechanics are meant to synergize, meaning that we want you to be able to cast spells and combine them strategically with other mechanics at your disposal for maximum effect. You’ll be able to form spell combinations with:  

🪄 [u]Other spells[/u]

Example: Casting an Ice Wall at one enemy to constrain it, then combining that with Weaver’s Grasp to break off parts of the wall to throw like projectiles at another foe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/f0c325ddd2c2d8a8fa6ec0c7fc3c6f1f20917aa6.gif[/img]

⚔️ [u]The unique abilities of magic-imbued weapons[/u] 

* Example: Using your kinetic-imbued bow & arrow to trap your enemy in a forcefield bubble, then casting flame magic at it to create an inferno (brutal).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/96b5d2f272ed832f3f8b972be4af8786b0e56822.gif[/img]

🌳 [u]The environment[/u]  

* Example: Using ice magic to pin a Drake to the ground or nearby structures, preventing it from taking flight to attack you from above. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/14ad50cfd3766964aeca387e599ff32f37cc2d1b.gif[/img]


[b]WHY COMBINE?  [/b]

Well, to be honest, it’s pretty fun. We think you’ll want to do it for that reason alone! But, there are of course net strategic advantages & benefits to well thought out and well-timed combinations too. Each spell on its own can give you great results if you become proficient enough with it. However, the unnatural weather of the Enclave can suddenly shift every time you venture out, changing the battlefield advantage in unpredictable ways. This means that good knowledge of your arsenal, your foes, and your surroundings will allow you to find creative ways to win no matter the circumstances.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/9b4c335b467e39cb6312b2b20870b9e6fe586aa7.gif[/img]

For example, the Ark of the Forge is a hammer wielding flame giant that can set its environment on fire. It’s in your best interest to avoid being near him on the ground for too long. While you could try to get up close with the right heat-resistant gear, avoiding its attacks to get a climbing grip on its leg – it’s a risky bet.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/7d825e1f5d800ccbbb7b00e144cce312fadb28c3.gif[/img]
 
An alternative approach, using the Cast & Combine system to your advantage, could look like casting an Ensnaring Blast on the Ark to create a bubble of gravity that attaches itself temporarily to your enemy. Then, combine that with an Ice Wall spell aimed at the kinetic bubble. The kinetic spell will pull in and hold the ice spell’s cold right against the Ark, causing the creature’s armor to become brittle and more susceptible to damage. You could also use the same spell combination on the ground to cool the flames propagated by the Ark’s hammer, allowing you to remain close by without risking heat damage.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/c1545f73a10dbb2a70f95b7bab06c86923cf0f1b.gif[/img]


[b]CREATIVE COMBINATIONS IN EXPLORATION & NAVIGATION [/b]
 
Finally, another way to use the cast & combine system in Eternal Strands is to help your traversal. As you travel further into The Enclave, you’ll stumble across extreme weather events, environmental obstacles and navigational challenges. To progress through these, you’ll sometimes need to experiment with your powers. For example: 
 

❄️ Some areas of The Enclave are permanently frozen. Accessing them (and their loot) will require creative spell & weapon combinations! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/2fd632e7d471daa059f83e05b9034cdd0382454c.gif[/img]

 
🚀 You can launch yourself through your kinetic stream to navigate quickly from point A to point B. If you level up the spell, you can keep creating streams while in flight to traverse a map in no time, or to leap instantly onto an Ark! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/f5827ce729fe279d48b93de5898af6159660f15a.gif[/img] 
 
[b]TOKYO GAME SHOW [/b]

We’re at Tokyo Game Show this week! Those who visit our booth get a chance to play our first Eternal Strands public demo 💫 Make sure to stop by if you’re planning to be at the event, we’d love to meet you and get your thoughts on the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/76af083be54a9be7d6b2919f119c55322292478a.png[/img]


What would you like us to do a deep dive on next? Follow us on social and comment to let us know! 


Twitter: https://twitter.com/YellowBrick_Qc 

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@yellowbrickgames_qc   

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@yellowbrickgames_qc   

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/yellowbrickgames/   

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/yellowbrickgames/   

Thanks again for your continued support! We’ve reached our beta milestone and are heading into the final stages of development. Very soon (Q1 2025), we’ll be able to share our game with you and we CAN’T WAIT!  
 
Until then, see you in the next update.  

The Yellow Brick Team 💛

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/744a9c08f09dd571af35cf73a4c91ecf840e56ed.png[/img]
Hello again, Weavers! 👋🏼 

In May, we shared our first Developer Update with you, in which we answered some of your most frequently asked questions about the game. Today, we want to dive a little deeper into the topic of the weapons in Eternal Strands: what they are, how they work and how they synergize with Brynn's powers.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/c2dd57de48d2f7293e6f54cebf0835b56e71101f.png[/img]
[b]Brynn can equip 3 weapons[/b] (one of each type) before leaving Basecamp to explore The Enclave: Sword & Shield, Bow & Arrow and Two-Hander. Using recipes that can be found during exploration, you'll learn how to craft elemental versions of each type of weapon, imbued with Kinetic, Frost, or Flame magic. [b]Each elemental weapon has a unique ability attached to it for a total of 9 different options. [/b]✨ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/9c0da7f291137ef644740deb99fe0a8f686f035a.png[/img]

[u]1. Sword & Shield ⚔️🛡️ [/u]

Your classic, good ol’ sword & shield weapon is always a great option for one-to-one dynamic combat at close range and an efficient tool in taking down Epics. Oh and, we forgot to mention: parrying! Who doesn’t love the feeling of a perfectly timed parry?💥🤌🏼 
 
Abilities for elemental Sword & Shields will allow Brynn to hurl multiple objects at enemies simultaneously, stick a delayed blast firebomb on an enemy before launching them away with a shield bash, or shoot ice in a straight line in front of her to freeze creatures that are in the way.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/0e044cb36e306bf8ae4b6f57358688e7ea35b09c.gif[/img]

[u]2. Bow & Arrow 🏹 [/u]

For those of us who prefer to keep some distance between ourselves and the enemy, the Bow & Arrow is our best friend. Its unique elemental abilities in Eternal Strands were designed to give the player lots of creative freedom in long-range combat. And finally, if you enjoy using precision aim with your Bow & Arrow, we're happy to share that this option will be available, along with a slow motion/time dilation feature that triggers while precision aim is active. 

Elemental Bow & Arrows will have the power to create kinetic bubbles or launch a series of ice beams on tagged targets.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/b8d08b9f1b3d760c06d7b2e4c26357208864ea35.gif[/img]

[u]3. Two-Hander ⚒️ [/u]

Swarmed? Fear not, your trusty Two-Hander weapon will help you thin out the crowd in no time. Combine it with one of the three elements in the game for more devastating, long-lasting effects.  
 
Abilities for elemental Two-Hander weapons will allow Brynn to swing her blade around her to create a sweeping 360° fire attack, spread ice lines across nearby enemies before bringing her weapon down to land a final strike, or create a stream of telekinetic magic to launch herself and/or surrounding adversaries into the air during combat.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/4e786a12cb793ea2643fa73cc1a78f129617d87b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/a6e46cb14bbc3a25c672a57d380eeb41149f8311.png[/img]
Creatures and objects will drop loot throughout your expeditions, which you can then use to craft the many available weapon combinations described above. The materials you use when crafting will affect your weapons’ stats (heat & cold resistance, strength, weight, etc.) and appearance!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/6e04b5d24cbc4e0ebc40e4a8faac15e93df0e551.png[/img]

*Disclaimer* Please note: all details mentioned in this article are subject to being edited or changed in the coming months, as the game is still in development. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/088af0299f3f3198276209b445a09999ac35a213.png[/img]
We will be at Gamescom next week! Accredited press and influencers will be given access to our first ever hands-on demo of Eternal Strands. We’ve been looking forward to this moment for years, and we couldn’t be more excited that it’s finally here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/8262dc1cde66f3390f91d2dba86f1d7ef03a62ea.png[/img]

Are you part of the accredited Media that will be at Gamescom while we’re there? If you want to book a demo, send us an email at press @ yellowbrickgames.ca to secure your spot.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/9c0da7f291137ef644740deb99fe0a8f686f035a.png[/img]

You won’t be at Gamescom, but you want to see what we’re up to while we’re there? Follow us on social!  

[b]‍Twitter[/b]: https://twitter.com/YellowBrick_Qc ‍ 
[b]YouTube[/b]: https://www.youtube.com/@yellowbrickgames_qc  ‍ 
[b]TikTok[/b]: https://www.tiktok.com/@yellowbrickgames_qc  ‍ 
[b]Instagram[/b]: https://www.instagram.com/yellowbrickgames/  ‍ 
[b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/yellowbrickgames/   

Thanks again for your continued support as we head into the final phase of Eternal Strands’ development. We can’t wait to show you more!   

The Yellow Brick Team

Abilities for elemental Two-Hander weapons will allow Brynn to swing her blade around her to create a sweeping 360° fire attack, spread ice lines across nearby enemies before bringing her weapon down to land a final strike, or create a stream of telekinetic magic to launch herself and/or surrounding adversaries into the air during combat.

notes.title: Developer Update #1
notes.content:
Welcome Weavers! 👋

It’s been a month since we first revealed our debut game, [b]Eternal Strands[/b], and the response from everyone has been such a joy to witness. We’ve been working on this game for over 4 years now, and your excitement has fueled our passion even further as we continue on the road to our Beta build later this year! 💛 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491410/

We are thrilled to kick off our very first Developer Update this month, and what better way to start than by shedding some light on the most frequently asked questions from our growing community? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/9c0da7f291137ef644740deb99fe0a8f686f035a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)[/b][/h1]

[h3]Is this game more of an RPG or an action-adventure title?[/h3]
Eternal Strands is a fully-fledged action-adventure title that offers action-packed combat with a storyline, numerous characters, and even some environmental puzzles that will utilize your magical powers. We look forward to telling you more about what we’ve been working on for you all in the coming weeks and months!  

[h3]Does the game have a character creator?[/h3]
Players will be embarking on the journey as Brynn, our protagonist, who is supported by a lively cast of characters. While you cannot change Brynn’s face or overall appearance, there are ways to customize her armor and weapons – stay tuned for more details! 

[h3]The game footage in previous videos looked buggy/clunky/washed out/not as good as it could be. Why?[/h3]
Please keep in mind that all of the footage we have shown thus far is from our early Alpha build – it only gets better from here as we move into Beta later this year!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/d449eba8ec38380014258410d15f15bcaf12f46b.png[/img]
[h3]How many weapons can we expect in the game?[/h3]
We have three main weapon types (e.g. sword & shield, bow & arrow, two-handed sword), but there are unique ways to customize all three in terms of stats and magic that is infused. Stay tuned for more information on this! 

[h3]Is this an open-world game?[/h3]
While we have a few biomes within Eternal Strands, we would not classify the game as “open world,” but rather “open zone.” There are some interconnected areas, but by and large, these biomes have limitations in when you can access them defined by your progression through the story. 

[h3]Is this a strand-type game?[/h3]
While we love Death Stranding and cannot wait for the sequel, we are not a strand-type game! 😅😶 

More seriously, the name Eternal Strands is linked to a number of things from our game: from Brynn’s Mantle that has magical strands woven into it, to the threads that bond our cast of characters together. We hope that you have fun discovering the meaning when you get to play the game yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/826308f6f34eaaf686bdeff13c30a8bbda7ccc5d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Will there be a mount or other ways of traversal?[/h3]
No mounts or gliders – however, you can find ways to creatively get across the world in speed and style with some of the powers! 😉 

[h3]Can you tell us more about crafting?[/h3]
We’re really excited to share more about our crafting system for Eternal Strands, but you’ll have to wait a little longer to hear more! But yes, there is crafting. 😊 

[h3]Will there be an AI party that supports you in combat?[/h3]
While Brynn will be fighting minions and giant enemies alone in the field, our cast of characters will still be able to comment on what she is doing in other ways. Stay tuned for more information! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/689b11ce195452d4cc909e848ac38ab5f5ae4fdb.png[/img]
[h3]Can you tell us more about the story - will there be big branching narrative choices?[/h3]
The story of Eternal Strands offers ways to build bonds and friendships with our rich cast of characters through dialogue choices. While the game itself does not have difficult moral choices that will sprawl out into multiple endings, or a giant social link system seen in games like Persona, you can still expect to see these dialogue choices impact Brynn’s personality and the way characters interact with her. We’re very eager to share more about our characters and their in-game interactions in the coming months, so stay tuned! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/c60faee40c33a41c75e23d0b0eedd1f1e16ebf16.png[/img]

[h3]What can you tell us about Brynn, the protagonist?[/h3]
Brynn is a badass treasure hunter and adrenaline junkie. She alone is responsible for diving headfirst into danger, and coming back with lost artifacts or treasure. Her expeditions are the driving force behind what her travelling companions are able to discover about the Enclave.  
 
She is the embodiment of the idea that “it’s cool to care,” and being unabashedly passionate about whatever it is you’re into. We can’t wait for players to meet her! 

[h3]Is there a dog we can pet?[/h3]
No dogs, but you can pet Arva. Who is Arva? You’ll have to find out! 😊 

[h3]Who is going to be composing the music?[/h3]
None other than legendary composer Austin Wintory, known for his work on projects like Journey, Stray Gods, and Assassin’s Creed Syndicate! 🎵💛 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/bc6deed19f8feafd0e6ce1762bcefc2ee5e39b6c.png[/img]
[h3]I’m a content creator - can I collaborate with the dev team or get a key to play the game?[/h3]
We’re working on something very special for our content creators that we’ll be announcing in June – keep your eyes peeled! 💛 

[h3]Will there be a public demo?[/h3]
We have nothing firm we can announce at this time, but we encourage you to follow our channels to stay tuned for more information as we have it!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/f4dfe25ad26b23a14e87569c95890ca373be0db9.png[/img]
[h3]When are we getting more information about the game?[/h3]
This summer, we are taking part in [url=https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow/videos]Future Games Show[/url] on June 8th where we will be revealing new details about the gameplay and story of Eternal Strands. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/656efd464f39dd49c40392f1aa45b17f4c350700.jpg[/img]

[h3]What system(s) will the game be releasing on?[/h3]
PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S!  

[h3]Are there any plans to release Eternal Strands physically?[/h3]
At this time, no plans – but we will absolutely update everyone if this changes! 

[h3]Is there a time machine we can borrow until launch?[/h3]
We’re working on one, but sadly most of our dev time is dedicated to working on the game. 😉 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959098/9c0da7f291137ef644740deb99fe0a8f686f035a.png[/img]

[b]To everyone who has decided to support us in this adventure so early on - thank you. [/b]💛 
Your passion for our game means everything to our studio, and we’re beyond grateful to see so much excitement around Eternal Strands! We hope you’ve enjoyed what we’ve shown so far, and we cannot wait to show you more of the world we’ve created for you all very soon.  

To be the first to know more about our game, make sure you follow us on socials:
